description: This file generates the detailed view page for a Quote in the SugarCRM-based system, including retrieving quote data, permissions, related modules, and rendering the Smarty template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record ID and module.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches display blocks for the detail view.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for the record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceNumber
methods.description: Gets the sequence number for the module record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence field for the module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for various actions.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category of the module.

methods.name: getDetailAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Fetches associated products for the quote.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks the status of buttons based on permissions.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into structured arrays.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related list modules.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Gets related modules from the session.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles navigation between records in detail view.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks permissions for specific fields.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Retrieves navigation info for list view.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Fetches all links of specified types for a module.
